Our apartments are designed to be your home away from home. Each space has been thoughtfully curated to combine modern comfort with the refined elegance that reflects the Renaissance heritage of Zamość.

Every apartment features high-quality furnishings, a fully equipped kitchen, comfortable beds with premium linens, and all the amenities you need for a relaxing stay.

- Security deposit may be required
